summary: Five inactive proofs extend the full curve-quotient model metric to arbitrary smooth curve backgrounds, including the zero-area singleton. Given a connected-fiber curve factor followed by a finite map of degree d, the two Gauduchon normalizations differ by d. Explicit logarithmic models over the squared-coordinate map show why pushing polar trace to the original base loses fiber-component information.
